Batch: 8 runs, all 8 accepted.
Flagged (1): r07, reason check_failed_but_accepted. Its closure value is 2.776, well above the 1.0 threshold, but the check is recorded as passed. The tip motion from the midline and stage log does not match the tip motion from the tracked kinematics. Its largest flank difference is at 347 µm, against 84 µm in every other run (z 6.38). That means the curvature-rate profile has a different shape. It also had no remedy and only one step.
Cleared (7): r01, r02, r03, r04, r05, r06, r08. All three checks pass. The REGR peak is at 421 µm and the largest flank difference is at 84 µm, matching the batch. Growth-zone length is 674–684 µm. r01's peak z of 2.88 comes from a batch MAD of 0. Its peak REGR is 53.24 against 53.1 %/h, so it is not an outlier.
Pattern: there is only one flagged run, so nothing is shared across runs. The problem in r07 is a closure check marked as passed even though its value is above the threshold. Please review how that check's pass/fail is recorded.
